title: A failed file transfer was described as checksum-verified and left the next executor without its input

source.evidence_note: Observed local historical transcript; see evidence/incident.md. Source aliases map privately; Submission of these prepared files was authorized on 2026-10-11.

horizon.intervening_work: Prepared and repeatedly reviewed a long execution handoff; a separate small view-file transfer succeeded. Reviews compared laptop source files and therefore could not certify remote delivery.
horizon.mechanism: Observed failure propagation and verification error, carried into a handoff. Unsupported-option root cause is supported by a later repeated attempt and assistant diagnosis; the original background output is not fully recovered here.

failure.expected_behavior: Prepare an execution handoff and place its required selection files on the destination workstation.
failure.observed_behavior: A transfer used an unsupported option and its shell pipeline ended successfully despite the transfer error. The handoff stated that required files were already checksum-verified on the destination. Later executor evidence and a checksum dry run showed that the main files were still absent.
failure.target_predicate: See checks/README.md; task completion and target error are assessed separately.

comparison_note: No model attempt or causal control has run. A scripted faulty fixture and correct reference, where recorded, validate the checker only.
